subject.title: fix: return preserved totalTokens from resolveFreshSessionTotalTokens when stale (fixes #82900)

question: Should `/context` intentionally show a stale token estimate as approximate, or should it continue to report an unavailable/unknown value until a fresh snapshot exists?
rationale: Current main already separates stale display from action eligibility in the Control UI, but extending that policy to the command surface requires a deliberate user-facing semantics decision rather than changing a shared freshness helper.

options.title: Use an explicit approximate display path
options.body: Keep the shared resolver fresh-only and add a command-specific presentation model that labels finite stale totals as approximate.

options.title: Preserve fresh-only command output
options.body: Leave `/context` unavailable until a fresh snapshot exists and close this branch as conflicting with the established freshness contract.

recommendation.title: Use an explicit approximate display path
recommendation.body: Keep the shared resolver fresh-only and add a command-specific presentation model that labels finite stale totals as approximate.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work owns the key stale-token compaction invariant that the decision must preserve.
